remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(hnetcfg.dll hnetcfg.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(hnetcfg regtypelib hnetcfg_tlb.idl)
add_idl_reg_objects(hnetcfg registry hnetcfg.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# hnetcfg.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hnetcfg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(hnetcfg_shims OBJECT apps.c hnetcfg.c manager.c policy.c port.c profile.c service.c)
target_link_libraries(hnetcfg_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload uuid oldnames msvcrtex libole32 liboleaut32 libwinhttp libws2_32 libshlwapi libadvapi32 libmpr libxmllite libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(hnetcfg_shims PRIVATE -Wno-old-style-declaration)
endif()
set_wine_module_fixme(hnetcfg_shims)
add_dependencies(hnetcfg_shims stdole2)
set(HNETCFG_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/hnetcfg/hnetcfg_r.o
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/hnetcfg/hnetcfg_tlb_t.o)
add_cargo_module(hnetcfg hnetcfg-cargo hnetcfg.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hnetcfg_shims hnetcfg_t hnetcfg_r ${HNETCFG_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
